primary_question: Does deployment-observable recoverability predict realized EXPLORE gain beyond uncertainty?
primary_estimand: forced-action tau_action(s) = U(force EXPLORE) - U(force ANSWER) inside the synthetic observation model (SIMULATOR_CAUSAL_WITHIN_MODEL). Secondary: availability tau_avail on the 120-query sanity fixture.
null_hypothesis: Deployment-safe recoverability does not add out-of-sample predictive information for Delta U_EXPLORE beyond uncertainty predictors.
alternative_hypothesis: A deployment-safe recoverability score improves registered-test Spearman/R2/AUROC for Delta U beyond entropy and belief margin.
primary_endpoint: cluster-bootstrap Spearman(DRS_proxy, Delta U_raw) minus Spearman(entropy, Delta U_raw) on split_role=registered_test
safety_endpoint: leakage audit (no gold, no future outcome in R_pre); sealed set unused for the gate decision
alpha_or_interval_policy: percentile cluster bootstrap 95% interval; no multiplicity correction across exploratory metrics
multiple_testing_family: confirmatory: primary Spearman difference and M1-M0 Spearman on registered_test only
sample_size_or_power: registered_test has 4 regimes x 3 beliefs x 3 costs = 36 states (cluster n=4). This detects only large effects; absence of significance is not equivalence.
exclusions: sealed_replication rows are stored and must not enter the gate decision
missing_data_policy: drop non-finite predictor/outcome pairs; do not impute
pass_rule: PASS if (a) leakage audit passes AND (b) cluster-bootstrap CI of Spearman(DRS)-Spearman(entropy) on registered_test excludes 0 with point>0 AND (c) M1-M0 Spearman CI excludes 0 with point>0 AND (d) the DRS-minus-entropy Spearman difference has the same sign on at least two registered regimes
partial_rule: PARTIAL if leakage passes and either (b) or (c) holds, or the quadrant contrast CI excludes 0, but not all PASS clauses
fail_rule: FAIL if leakage fails, or both confirmatory incremental intervals include 0 or have non-positive point estimates
inconclusive_rule: INCONCLUSIVE if Spearman is undefined or fewer than two registered regimes have finite Spearman
notes: T2 Lipschitz bound is a certificate, never Q(s, EXPLORE).
120-query fixture is a regression/availability sanity arm, not the confirmatory Gate-1 test.
Identification status for synthetic forced-action: SIMULATOR_CAUSAL_WITHIN_MODEL.
